jobs.description: We are looking for a BlueField Platform Tech Lead — a senior individual contributor who will own the end-to-end technical architecture of the BF platform stack. This role is the single authoritative voice across both the ARM SoC / boot firmware layer (ATF, UEFI, Linux bring-up) and the BMC layer (Yocto, embedded Linux, platform management). You will guide current BlueField generations and set the technical direction for future ones. Do you enjoy leading the whole system rather than one piece of it, and making the decisions that keep it working together? This position is for you. What you’ll be doing: Own the end-to-end technical architecture and roadmap for the BlueField platform. This covers SoC boot, platform firmware (ATF/UEFI), the DPU BMC, and the interfaces between the DPU, the host and the BMC. Set the platform’s technical direction with architecture, hardware, NIC firmware, software stack and product teams. Make sure decisions stay consistent across BlueField generations and product variants. Define and maintain platform interface contracts, including boot and reset flows, firmware update and recovery, platform management (Redfish, PLDM, MCTP, IPMI), and BMC–SoC communication. Own platform security architecture together with the security teams: secure boot, measured boot, attestation, key and provisioning flows, and secure firmware update. Act as the technical lead for new silicon and board bring-up. Assess hardware issues, define workarounds, and drive readiness criteria for achievements and releases. Serve as the technical reference for customers and partners. Translate platform requirements and use cases into architecture and design decisions. Assess emerging technologies, standards, tools and development methods, such as automation, emulation/simulation, observability and failure triage. Drive adoption where they improve product quality, engineering efficiency or time to debug. Raise the organization’s technical skills through build reviews, technical mentorship and collaborative discussions. What we need to see: A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field. 12+ years of experience in embedded, firmware or Linux system software. Deep expertise in at least one of the two domains below, and solid working knowledge of the other: 1. ARM platform boot: ATF, UEFI/EDK II, bootloaders, Linux kernel bring-up, device tree/ACPI, platform initialization 2. BMC and platform management: OpenBMC, Redfish interface, PLDM protocol, MCTP communication, IPMI standards, firmware update flows A strong grasp of platform security principles, including secure boot, chain of trust and firmware security. A record of leading difficult cross-organizational technical projects from definition through delivery, including decisions with material product or schedule impact. Experience influencing architecture and product direction through technical judgment, without relying on direct management authority. Strong C skills and practical experience in Linux development, debugging, and hardware/software integration. Excellent communication and technical presentation skills, including with customers and senior stakeholders. Ways to stand out from the crowd: Hands-on experience with both ARM SoC/server boot flows (ATF, UEFI) and BMC software (OpenBMC, Yocto). Experience with trusted boot processes, attestation (SPDM), provisioning, firmware update or recovery architectures. Knowledge of server-platform interfaces: PCIe, I2C/I3C, SPI, SMBus, NC-SI, and reset and power sequencing. Experience with DPU, SmartNIC or data-center server platforms, and with networking protocols. Experience building automated test, emulation, observability or failure-triage infrastructure, or introducing tools that clearly improved team efficiency. jobs.description: NVIDIA has been redefining computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. We are looking for a Senior Research Scientist passionate about AI system optimization. Are you excited to shape the future of large-scale generative AI, NVIDIA is at the forefront of foundation models and generative AI systems, enabling cutting-edge research and real-world deployment at unprecedented scale. Our team is dedicated to enhancing the efficiency of large-scale, distributed AI training and serving, through optimization of scale-up and scale-out networking. Join us to work with world-class researchers and engineers on building the next generation of AI systems. What you will be doing: Identify and study unique requirements imposed by next-gen AI models, to analyze potential impacts on network, memory and storage Conduct high-impact research of advanced AI technologies (e.g. quantization, speculative decoding, memory-augmentation, etc) Propose optimizations for training and serving emerging AI models, ahead of general availability (GA) Collaborate with multi-functional teams to demonstrate potential benefits on state-of-the-art NVIDIA hardware (NVLink, Spectrum-X, GPU) What we need to see: We need a technical leader who can identify complex system bottlenecks and mentor multi-disciplinary engineering teams. M. Sc in Computer Science/Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent research experience At least 8 years of relevant industry experience Proven track record of delivering performance improvements in distributed AI training/serving through innovative optimizations Experience in working with common ML frameworks, such as PyTorch and TensorFlow Ways to stand out from the crowd: PhD with focus on AI/ML optimization Strong track record of publications and patents related to distributed AI training/serving Experience in optimizing communication algorithms, memory access patterns and communication/computation overlap Knowledge/hands-on experience in network fabrics and protocols (NVLink, IB, RoCE) Excellent leadership skills with experience driving software-hardware co-design in a cross-functional environment NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you! jobs.description: We are seeking an experienced QA engineer to join our SW testing team. This position will be part of our growing team, which enables NVIDIA products to meet the industry-leading benchmarks of efficiency and quality. We develop a collaborative and inclusive work environment, where ideas are shared and innovation is encouraged. As a QA Engineer in this group, you will be immersed in the latest advancements and actively contribute to developing world-class products. Your efforts will directly impact the performance and quality of our offerings, ensuring they consistently meet industry-leading standards. We are looking for an ideal candidate with proven QA experience who will be actively involved in testing industry-leading features in the Networking sector, can acquire new feature knowledge, conduct both manual and automated tests, and contribute to the development of automation systems. The ideal candidate should bring a robust understanding for SW release cycle and the QA part in it. What you'll be doing: Review arch design and requirements documents for new features introduced in several domains like NVLINK, NV Switches , Nvidia GPUs, and more Design, develop, and perform tests for the new features, as part of FW GA or update releases Automate newly added tests in the existing automation framework, and add new capabilities and features to the framework Report bugs found during execution, assist with reproduction and debugs to understand root cause, verify bug fixes provided by R&D team, and raise if not fixed Conduct tests in various areas, including regression, performance, functional, and security. Keep track of testing progress and generate summary reports of testing activities Fully collaborate with different external teams like : :product marketing, R&D, and verification. Define and build setups topologies for appropriate product coverage What we need to see: B.Sc. in Computer Science or Electrical/Electronics Engineering 2+ years of proven experience in QA Advanced Python coding skills Proven experience in QA - methodologies, and test design. Clear verbal and written communication, proficient in written and spoken English. Self-reliant individual, capable of planning and carrying out tasks within their assigned area Personal: good interpersonal skills, quick learner, proactive, innovative, highly motivated, and committed Ways to stand out from the crowd: Experience with release management, V&V, E2E testing Working in fast-paced environment with multiple parallel running activities Knowledge/experience in Networking protocols At NVIDIA, we are dedicated to pushing technological boundaries and providing exceptional customer experiences. If you are ready to join a world-class team and contribute to the success of innovative products, we want to hear from you. Apply now and take the next step in your engineering career with NVIDIA.
